text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"3 hammers in June"},{"id":"q2","value":4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"4 hammers in July"},{"id":"q3","value":6,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"6 hammers in August"},{"id":"q4","value":9,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"9 hammers in September"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"find the increase from June to July (4-3)"},{"op":"sub","args":["q3","q2"],"out":"s2","note":"find the increase from July to August (6-4)"},{"op":"sub","args":["q4","q3"],"out":"s3","note":"find the increase from August to September (9-6)"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","s1"],"out":"s4","note":"find how much the monthly increase itself is growing (second difference)"},{"op":"add","args":["s3","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"project the next monthly increase by adding that growth to September's increase"},{"op":"add","args":["q4","s5"],"out":"s6","note":"add the projected increase to September's order to get October's order, following the pattern"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"hammers ordered in October if the pattern continues"},"dismissed":[]}
